proposal:
Here is the canonicalized PostgreSQL `SELECT` statement:

```sql
SELECT
    o.observstation AS observatory_name,
    o.lunarstage AS current_moon_phase,
    AVG(o.lunardistdeg) AS average_lunar_interference,
    COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS count_of_problematic_events
FROM
    observatories AS o
JOIN
    telescopes AS t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
JOIN
    signals AS s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
GROUP BY
    o.observstation, o.lunarstage
ORDER BY
    average_lunar_interference;
```

This query remains the same as it is already well-formatted and follows PostgreSQL conventions. The column names, types, ordering, and parameter positions are preserved.
